sip.title: [v0.93.1][defect] Report dashboard JavaScript validation as skipped or failed when Node is missing
sip.goal: Make the milestone dashboard validation result truthful when Node is unavailable.
sip.required_outcome: The script distinguishes static-only validation from executed JavaScript syntax, rendering, and escaping assertions, while preserving the existing Node-present checks.
sip.acceptance_criteria: Node absent cannot report behavioral validation PASS; Node present retains actual syntax, rendering, and escaping assertions; focused tests assert distinct executed and skipped outcomes.
sip.inputs: Issue #1261 and the reviewed Runtime72 dashboard-validation finding.
sip.target_files_surfaces: adl/tools/test_milestone_dashboard.sh and one focused Node test for its Node-present and Node-absent result contract.
sip.validation_plan: Run the focused Node test, run the dashboard validator directly with Node present, run git diff --check, and obtain independent pre-PR review.
sip.demo_proof_requirements: Focused local assertions over both dependency branches; no live Runtime, deployment, provider, or broad Rust proof.
sip.non_goals: No dashboard product change, no live sync work, no v0.95 expansion, no runtime restart, and no unrelated validation refactor.
sip.notes_risks: A zero exit in the Node-absent branch is acceptable only with an explicit SKIP result that cannot be mistaken for behavioral PASS.

stp.title: [v0.93.1][defect] Report dashboard JavaScript validation as skipped or failed when Node is missing
stp.summary: Correct the dashboard validation result contract without changing dashboard behavior.
stp.task_summary: Emit truthful, distinct Node-present and Node-absent validation outcomes and assert both paths.
stp.goal: Prevent static-only validation from being labeled as full dashboard PASS.
stp.required_outcome: Node-present execution reports behavioral validation executed; Node-absent execution reports behavioral validation skipped and never prints the full PASS result.
stp.deliverables: Surgical shell diagnostic/result correction and one focused regression test exercising both dependency paths.
stp.acceptance_criteria: Both paths exit intentionally, expose distinct truthful status, and the Node-present path still runs syntax, rendering, origin-policy, and escaping assertions.
stp.repo_inputs: Issue #1261, adl/tools/test_milestone_dashboard.sh, and the current dashboard fixture files.
stp.dependencies: Current native v3 authority and an installed Node executable for the focused test runner; no product runtime dependency.
stp.validation_plan: Run node --test for the focused regression, run the dashboard script directly, run git diff --check, and complete bounded independent review.
stp.demo_proof_requirements: The focused test must assert the exact outcome markers and that the Node-absent run has no behavioral PASS marker.
stp.non_goals: No dashboard content change, runtime work, provider calls, deployment, or broad repository validation.
stp.issue_graph_notes: Bounded prerequisite repair before #1223; Runtime72 audit is evidence, not a runtime implementation dependency.
stp.notes_risks: The absence simulation must remove Node from the child PATH without weakening the static checks.
stp.tooling_notes: Use native v3 lifecycle in the bound FastWork worktree and the smallest proving Node lane.
